test_title: SSC GD Constable 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

'A + B' means 'A is the daughter of B',

'A - B' means 'A is the brother of B',

'A × B' means 'A is the wife of B' and

'A ÷ B' means 'A is the father of B.

Based on the above, how is P related to T if 'P + Q ÷ R - S × T'?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be05ce3b9646091ae6ace1a32df5f012370c92c5faea26ed35998686d3e81abd.png]

Given: P + Q ÷ R - S × T

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3811811545386b0dd2d88cb406324946e50d25dddb4f76f90f6c5cc35dbf521b.png] 

Since P, R, and S are siblings, P is the sister of S. S is the wife of T. Therefore, P is the sister-in-law of T.

Thus, P is the **Wife's sister** of T.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 4".**
